value.deck: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs now features persistent memory across sessions and Ollama integration for local model execution.
shortVersion: GitHub has updated Copilot for JetBrains IDEs with persistent memory and support for Ollama, a tool that runs AI models locally on your hardware. This update aligns with a broader trend toward hybrid AI architectures that combine cloud performance with local privacy controls. By bringing both capabilities into one IDE workflow, developers can now switch between cloud and local AI assistance depending on their needs.

The persistent memory feature retains context across sessions, which improves Copilot's usefulness for long-running software projects. Meanwhile, Ollama support enables privacy-conscious developers to run local models alongside cloud-based Copilot without leaving their JetBrains environment. For software teams, the practical consequence is greater control over code privacy and less friction when managing context across complex tasks.
